title: Meet Your Flute
description: Get to know your bansuri - inspect it, find your comfortable hold, and set your Sa pitch.

title: Body, Breath, First Sound
description: Learn sitting posture, low breathing, and produce your first clear note on Sa.

title: First Sound on Sa
description: Develop a steady, clear Sa with consistent tone and begin ear training.

title: Long Tones and Your Sa Pitch
description: Build breath control with sustained tones and train your pitch accuracy.

title: Sa - The Home Note
description: Learn why Sa is the foundation of all Indian music and prove you can hold it steady.

title: Sa Re Ga - Your First Three Notes
description: Open your first finger holes, hear the intervals, and play a short phrase with three notes.

title: First Alankars
description: Learn alankar patterns - the melodic exercises that build finger speed and musical patterns.

title: Lower Ni - The Seventh Note Below
description: Discover the lower Ni and understand the concept of octaves on the bansuri.

title: Sargam Theory Challenge
description: Test your knowledge of the seven swaras, their names, and their relationships.

title: Ma and Pa - Expanding Your Range
description: Add Ma and Pa to your vocabulary, play the first five notes, and start hearing the pentatonic scale.

title: Shuddha Ma and Half-Holing
description: Master the half-hole technique needed for shuddha Ma and many notes to come.

title: Your First Melody
description: Combine everything you have learned into your first real melody. Learn about phrasing, breath control, and musical expression.

title: Dha and Ni - The Full Saptak
description: Learn the last two swaras and play all seven notes of the saptak for the first time.

title: Rhythm and Laya - Finding the Beat
description: Discover tala and laya - the rhythmic foundation that turns notes into music.

title: Learning a Song by Ear
description: Develop the skill of learning melodies by listening - the traditional way of Indian music.

title: Upper Register and Taal
description: Learn to play Pa, Dha, Ni in the upper octave and understand basic taal (rhythm cycle).

title: Intonation - Playing in Tune
description: Develop fine pitch control and learn to hear the subtle differences that make notes 'in tune'.

title: Meend - Slides Between Notes
description: Master the art of meend (gliding between notes) - the ornament that gives bansuri its singing voice.

title: What Is a Raga?
description: Understand the concept of raga - the melodic framework that defines Indian classical music.

title: Raga Yaman - Your First Raga
description: Enter the world of ragas through Yaman - the evening raga that every student learns first.

title: Keys and Transposition
description: Understand how bansuri sizes correspond to keys and how to transpose between them.

title: Bhatkhande Notation
description: Read and write the standard Indian music notation system used in textbooks and compositions.

title: Western Staff Notation
description: Read Western staff notation so you can use sheet music resources and communicate with Western musicians.

title: Kan, Khatka and Murki
description: Learn three essential ornaments that give bansuri melodies their characteristic sparkle.

title: Komal Swaras - The Flats
description: Learn the four komal (flat) notes and the half-holing technique that unlocks them on the bansuri.

title: Tivra Ma - The Raised Fourth
description: Discover the only raised note in Indian music and complete your knowledge of all 12 swaras.

title: Raga Bhupali - Five Pure Notes
description: Learn the pentatonic raga Bhupali - five shuddha notes that form one of the most beautiful melodies in Indian music.

title: Raga Durga - The Evening Pentatonic
description: Explore Raga Durga - a pentatonic raga with shuddha Ma that introduces your first half-hole in a raga context.

title: Raga Kafi - The Dorian Sound
description: Learn Raga Kafi with its komal Ga and komal Ni - a raga of warmth, rain, and longing.

title: Raga Bhairavi - The Morning Raga
description: Explore the deeply emotional Bhairavi - a raga with four komal notes that tests your half-holing mastery.

title: Improvise and Compose
description: Learn to create your own melodies within the framework of a raga.

title: Gamak and Andolan
description: Master the oscillation and slow vibrato that bring ragas to life at the advanced level.

title: Bandish, Taans and Tihai
description: Learn the structure of compositions, fast melodic runs, and the rhythmic cadence that ends a section.

title: Alap and Swar Vistar
description: Explore the slow, meditative opening of a raga - the alap - and the art of note-by-note development.

title: Accompaniment - Playing with Others
description: Learn to play with tabla, tanpura, and other musicians - the social side of Indian music.

title: Performing - Sharing Your Music
description: Prepare for playing in front of others - from informal sessions to stage performance.

title: Style and Gharana
description: Explore different bansuri playing styles and the gharana traditions that shaped them.

title: A Full Raga Presentation
description: Bring everything together - present a complete raga from alap to jhala, the final test of mastery.

title: Common Mistakes Clinic
description: Diagnose and fix the most frequent beginner errors - embouchure, finger coverage, tension, and tone.

title: Advanced Alankars
description: Master skip patterns, zigzags, wide intervals, and speed building exercises for finger independence.

title: The 10 Thaats
description: Learn the 10 parent scales of Hindustani music - the thaat system that classifies every raga.

title: Raga Time Theory
description: Discover the prahar system - why ragas are assigned to specific times of day and how to predict them.

title: Raga Families and Lookalikes
description: Learn to distinguish ragas that share the same notes but differ in treatment, emphasis, and phrasing.

title: Shruti and Tuning
description: Explore the 22-shruti system, just intonation, and microtonal ear training for advanced pitch awareness.

title: Tihai Mathematics
description: Master the 3P + 2G = T formula to calculate and design tihais for any taal cycle.

title: Raga Malkauns - The Midnight Pentatonic
description: Explore the powerful pentatonic night raga with all komal notes and no Re or Pa.

title: Raga Desh - The Patriotic Evening Raga
description: Learn the beloved Khamaj thaat raga with its distinctive dual-Ni treatment.

title: Taal Deep Dive
description: Master Jhaptaal, Rupak, Ektaal, Dadra and Keherwa - the essential taals beyond Teentaal.

title: Breath Mastery
description: Advanced breathing techniques - diaphragmatic control, breath economy, and the prana connection.

title: Practice Planning
description: Structure your daily riyaz for maximum improvement - the five-part session and goal setting.

title: Concert Listening Guide
description: Learn to actively listen to Hindustani classical performances - from alap to drut climax.

title: Tongue Techniques
description: Master single, double, and triple tonguing plus gitkiri for articulation and speed.

title: Raga Bageshree - The Sweet Night Raga
description: Explore the beloved Kafi thaat night raga with its vakra ascent and romantic longing.

title: Raga Todi - The Morning Challenge
description: Tackle one of the 'big six' ragas - three komal notes plus tivra Ma in a profound morning raga.

title: Dhrupad and Khayal
description: Understand the two pillars of Hindustani classical music and how they shape bansuri playing.

title: Thumri and Light Classical
description: Explore thumri, dadra, bhajan, and ghazal - genres where emotion takes centre stage.

title: Bansuri Care and Selection
description: Choose, maintain, and understand the bamboo flute - from oiling to building a collection.

title: Advanced Ear Training
description: Full chromatic note identification, komal vs shuddha discrimination, and raga recognition by ear.

title: Register Mastery
description: Play fluently across mandra, madhya, and taar saptaks with smooth register transitions.

title: Raga Marwa - The Sunset Raga
description: Master the intense sunset raga with no Pa and a de-emphasized Sa - one of the 'big six' ragas.

title: Raga Bihag - The Late Night Jewel
description: Learn the melodious late-night raga with dual Ma and vakra ascent - sweet with depth.

title: Layakari - Rhythmic Play
description: Master dugun, tigun, and chaugun - the art of playing with rhythm within a taal cycle.

title: Dynamics and Expression
description: Volume control, tonal color, vibrato, and rasa - the art of expressive bansuri playing.

title: Meditation and Bansuri
description: The spiritual dimension of bansuri - nada yoga, mindfulness, and the breath-sound connection.

title: Bansuri in Film Music
description: The bansuri's role in Indian cinema - from iconic soundtracks to its unique emotional power.

title: Indian Music History
description: From the Samaveda to Pannalal Ghosh - 3,000 years of music in one journey.

title: Raga Hansadhwani - The Swan's Call
description: The auspicious pentatonic raga from Carnatic tradition - five pure notes that soar like a swan.

title: Raga Shivranjani - The Beloved Pentatonic
description: The hugely popular pentatonic raga with komal Ga - tender, emotional, and perfect for film melodies.

title: Raga Ahir Bhairav - The Pastoral Morning
description: The beloved morning compound raga blending Bhairav and Kafi - warm, pastoral, perfect for bansuri.

title: Taan Patterns and Types
description: Master sapat, vakra, gamak, and leaping taans - the fast melodic runs that add brilliance to performance.

title: Cross-Fingering and Alternate Fingerings
description: Alternate fingerings, venting, harmonics, and extended techniques that expand the bansuri's range.

title: Circular Breathing
description: The advanced technique for unbroken phrases - inhale through the nose while sustaining the note.

title: Recording Your Bansuri
description: Home recording basics - microphone placement, room acoustics, and building a practice archive.

title: Raga Jaunpuri - The Late Morning Raga
description: The gentle contemplative morning raga of Asavari thaat with komal Ga and komal Dha.

title: Raga Pilu - The Mishra Raga
description: The most versatile raga in Hindustani music - a mishra raga allowing both shuddha and komal Ga, Dha, Ni.

title: Raga Kedar - The Devotional Evening
description: One of the 'big six' ragas with dual Ma and a devotional character - the mountain raga of Kedarnath.

title: Jugalbandi - Duet Playing
description: The art of musical conversation - sawal-jawab, deep listening, and performing with another soloist.

title: Swara Sadhana - Note Practice
description: The disciplined, meditative practice of individual notes - the foundation of all mastery.

title: Nyas and Vistar - Resting and Developing
description: Resting notes and melodic development - the two concepts that define how a raga unfolds.

title: Stage and Sound - Live Performance Setup
description: Microphone selection, stage setup, sound checks, and home recording for bansuri performers.
